operator_request: 15.10.2026: «Vi skal ikke behandle M5 som falsifisert på det nye datasettet når det ikke er gjennomført trening på dette datagrunnlaget. ... Lag en liten, forhåndsdefinert studie med beslutninger etter lukket M5-bar og horisonter på 30, 120 og 360 minutter. Bruk en enkel lineær modell og XGBoost som referanser. La transformeren være en avgrenset utfordrer ... A: Eksisterende pris-/tekniske felt. B: Samme oppsett med den nye, utvidede featureflaten. C: Senere samme oppsett med GC-data, dersom et kjøp godkjennes.»
research_scope: offline CPU research arm under GX1_RULES (forskningsbaselines med egen deklarert enkel logikk); no native contract, head, recipe or serving authority changes; no GPU; TEST never read

data.availability_audit: GX1_RUNS/M5_RECHECK_20261015_001/audit: every one of the 61 D1 fields reconstructed independently at all 723 432 decision rows (drivers D+2 00:00 New York strict, COT as_of+7d strict: 0 differing cells); panel D1 bars contain no H1 bar ending after their stamp; MTF context fields change only at their bar closes

decision_clock: every dataset row; decision time = row time (M5 bar open) + 300 s, i.e. after the closed M5 bar

A.description: existing price/technical surface: snap fields 0..253 (identical names, order and values to HISTORY2009W_FEATURE_REPAIR_20261010) + one-hot session_id

B.description: A + the 61 D1 macro/positioning/panel fields (snap 254..314) + one-hot session_id

C.description: B + GC futures fields; NOT RUN: requires an approved data purchase

execution.entry: first M1 bar with time >= decision + latency; long at its ask_open, short at its bid_open; censored if that bar starts more than 300 s after decision + latency
execution.exit: first M1 bar with time >= entry bar time + horizon; long at its bid_open, short at its ask_open; censored if that bar starts more than 4200 s after the target time or if any gap > 6 h (weekly closure) lies between entry and exit
execution.spread: carried by the executable bid/ask prices; never deducted again

financing.rule: per 17:00 America/New_York rollover crossed between entry and exit: long -0.0569/365, short +0.0323/365 of notional (source rates of CURRENT_TERMS_POLICY_001)

learning_target: y_h = 1e4 * ln(mid_exit / mid_entry) with mid = (bid_open + ask_open) / 2 at the entry and exit M1 bars (cost-free mid return over the executed window); censored rows excluded from training and evaluation

ridge.form: closed-form ridge on features standardized with train-window statistics, NaN -> 0 after standardization, intercept unpenalized

gbdt.library: lightgbm 4.6.0 (stand-in for XGBoost: xgboost is not installed in the bound .venv and adding it changes the environment the GPU gates bind; same model class, histogram GBDT)
gbdt.selection: best inner-validation iteration; refit on the whole train window with that round count

transformer.design: native v10 function on the same rows, targets and periods; the three most recent evaluation periods; the horizon with the best reference rank-IC on the earlier periods (chosen without the challenger periods); feature set B; one fresh initialization per period
blocked_by: no minute-horizon target contract (entry_observed_market_horizons_v1 binds 1/5/20 trading days; the 95-minute v1 contract is a different target)
fresh physical Windows boot per GPU invocation (one boot per period)

walk_forward.purge: train rows whose exit time >= evaluation start are removed; embargo: train rows with decision >= evaluation start - 1 day are removed
walk_forward.inner_validation: last 20% of the purged train window by decision time; inner-train rows whose exit time >= inner-validation start are removed
walk_forward.fit_only_on: normalization statistics, ridge alpha, GBDT round count and every threshold come from the train window / inner validation only

trading_rule.primary: process evaluation decisions in time order; when flat and both entry and exit are uncensored: c = spread_bps at the last M1 bar closed at the decision (ask_close - bid_close over mid) + 2 x central slippage; enter LONG if prediction > c, SHORT if prediction < -c; hold exactly the horizon; the next decision is considered only at a decision time >= the exit time
trading_rule.secondary_reported_not_decisive: same sequencing; enter in the sign of the prediction when |prediction| exceeds the 90th percentile of |prediction| over the inner-validation block (no cost threshold)
trading_rule.drift_baseline: always LONG with the same one-position sequencing (and always SHORT), same costs

metrics.prediction: per period: Spearman rank-IC and Pearson correlation of prediction vs y_h, sign hit rate, R2 against zero; across the 11 periods: mean, sd and t of the per-period rank-IC
metrics.trading: per period and pooled: trades, net bps total and per trade, win rate, exposure (time in market over period length), max drawdown of the cumulative net per trade (bps), at slippage 1/2/3/4 bps with decisions fixed at the central rule
metrics.a_versus_b: per model and horizon: paired per-period difference in rank-IC and in pooled net per trade

classification.cells: 2 models x 2 feature sets x 3 horizons = 12 cells (primary rule)
classification.bootstrap: calendar-week blocks of trades (by entry), 4000 replicates, seed 20261015; two-sided 90% interval and a Bonferroni family interval at 1 - 0.10/12
classification.PROMISING: family-adjusted lower bound of net per trade > 0 AND positive net in >= 60% of the periods with >= 5 trades AND pooled net per trade still > 0 at 3 bps slippage AND >= 30 trades
classification.NEGATIVE: >= 30 trades AND the raw 90% upper bound of net per trade < 0
classification.prediction_signal: per cell: mean per-period rank-IC with t >= 3.0 across periods reads as a stable ranking signal; it is reported separately and never converts a trading NEGATIVE into PROMISING
